user.title: Track a beacon
user.description: Pick the phone (companion app BLE transmitter) or type an iBeacon id (uuid_major_minor) or a fixed MAC address. The rooms come from the areas of your Bluetooth proxies.

data_description.name: Used in the entity names, for example 'Cyril' gives sensor.cyril_room.
data_description.interactive_entity: Optional. Screen off = the phone lies still: the room holds better.
data_description.bssid_entity: Optional. With the floor list in the options, a room on another floor is harder to pick.
data_description.use_motion: Motion in a room makes a switch to that room faster.

error.bad_beacon: Not a valid iBeacon id (uuid_major_minor) or MAC address.

data.still_margin: Switch margin when the phone is still
data.still_dwell: Switch time when the phone is still

data_description.bssid_floors: One per line: BSSID = floor id, for example aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff = upstairs.
data_description.margin: How much stronger (dB) a new room must be.
data_description.dwell: How long the new room must stay stronger.
